params.body:
## Why

Car-Pass accepts one odometer reading per user, vehicle and reading date (Car-Pass Inflow API, https://car-pass.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CarPassInflow/overview). Until now the platform did not count: a second click the same day went out and came back as a Car-Pass refusal about a rule the platform could have applied itself (rule R S3-3.7, finding X-04). Ilse decided on 2026-09-17 (acceptance test V-4): **we count ourselves and block the button**.

## What changes for the dealer

- In the own-stock list, a vehicle that already had a reading registered today shows the chip **"Vandaag al aangevraagd om HH:MM"** (with a hint) instead of the "Car-Pass aanvragen" button. Tomorrow the button is back. Same visual form as the existing "Car-Pass in aanvraag" chip (amber, logo); no new CSS.
- A second request the same day, from any caller, is refused **before anything leaves**: the sheet is not touched, no HTTP call is made, and the dealer sees "Vandaag al aangevraagd om HH:MM" as a message.
- A correction or confirmation on today's observation still goes out: that is how today's reading is repaired.
- A refusal by Car-Pass (an observation that got no requestGuid) does not use up the day: the dealer fixes the sheet and tries again.
- Every refusal that is not handled by the confirm or correction dialog is shown with Car-Pass's own message (`ui.notify`, error tone). The Livewire list already did this for every answer shape; the new refusal goes the same way. The classic route `ownvehicle.update.carpass_request` returns the same array and is no longer wired to any screen (the sheet has no request button any more; the sold tab shares the row partial).

## How

- `App\Support\CarpassToday`: derives "registered today" from the stored request rows (`carpass_requests`, `is_request = 1` with a `requestGuid`, created today). Nothing new is stored: no `carpass_requested_at` column was needed, the request log already carries the fact.
- `CarpassController::carpassRequest`: guard for `action === 'observation'` right after the action is resolved and before the vehicle update, returning `['status' => 'error', 'error' => 1, 'refused' => 'today', 'message' => ...]`.
- `CarpassPending::forPage()`: pending and today from ONE query per page (the existing test that pins "one question for the page" still holds).
- `OwnStockList::render` passes `carpass_today`; `_wagen_rij.blade.php` gets one `@elseif` branch (hot file, minimal, one chip).
- Lang keys `ownstock.carpass_today` and `ownstock.carpass_today_hint` in nl/fr/en/de (`ownstock.php`, not `ui.php`).

## Rule text for R S3-3.7 (to fold into `docs/bedrijfsregels/13-s3-car-pass.md`, which another PR is rewriting)

> | R S3-3.7 | Car-Pass aanvaardt één kilometerstand per gebruiker, wagen en registratiedatum (Car-Pass Inflow API). Het platform telt dat zelf: een nieuwe observatie voor een wagen waarvoor vandaag al een kilometerstand aanvaard werd (een aanvraagrij met requestGuid in `carpass_requests`) wordt geweigerd vóór er iets vertrekt, met het uur van die registratie; in het eigen wagenpark toont de rij dan "Vandaag al aangevraagd om HH:MM" in plaats van de knop. Een correctie of bevestiging op de observatie van vandaag mag wel; een weigering van Car-Pass (geen requestGuid) verbruikt de dag niet. Elke weigering die de dialoog niet afhandelt wordt met de melding van Car-Pass zelf getoond. | klant | `App\Support\CarpassToday`, `CarpassController::carpassRequest` (guard), `CarpassPending::forPage`, `OwnStockList::render`, `resources/views/ownstock/_wagen_rij.blade.php` | beslist Ilse 2026-09-17 (V-4) |

Finding X-04 can be set to `opgelost` (2026-09-17, beslist Ilse) in the same fold.

## Tests

New `tests/Feature/CarpassOncePerDayTest.php` (6 tests, all tagged `@rule S3-3.7`): second observation same day refused with zero HTTP calls and an untouched sheet; next day allowed (time travel); a refused observation does not count; a correction on today's observation still goes out; the list dispatches the refusal with the hour and sends nothing; the row shows the hour instead of the button (partial and full Livewire render). `CarpassPollingAndPendingTest::test_an_issue_is_not_a_pending_request` updated: an issue today is not pending, but the row now says the hour instead of offering a button whose observation Car-Pass would refuse.

Run locally: `Carpass*`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `OwnStockRowPublishedDaysTest`, `ProposalPublicPageTest`, `ScheduleTest`: OK (133 tests, 637 assertions, 1 pre-existing incomplete).

## Open point

After an issue the dealer left unanswered (dialog cancelled), the row says "Vandaag al aangevraagd" and offers no way back into the correction dialog until tomorrow. Before this PR the button was there but sent a new observation that Car-Pass refused, so nothing is lost; a chip that reopens the correction on today's observation would be the next step.
params.title: Car-Pass: the platform counts one request per vehicle per day itself and shows every refusal
